source.title: Newry Telegraph, 3 October 1946, p. 6 ("Kilkeel Rural District Council: two contests")
source.publisher: Newry Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes from the Belfast News-Letter (5 October 1946, p. 3), checked against the Newry Reporter (21 September 1946, p. 1); unopposed returns from the Newry Telegraph (3 October 1946, p. 6).

note: Triennial election of the Kilkeel Rural District Council, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Maghera and Lisnacree were contested; the other divisions were uncontested, but the newspaper does not tie the unopposed names to divisions. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
